rationale: The one concern still live at this diff's head is the unvalidated global default change affecting ~14 non-Qwen diffusion models — Y nails this with near-exact model list and even proposes the same fix mechanism (_DIFFUSION_IR_OP_PRIORITY_FUNCS/registry) that hsliuustc0106 suggested, and separately reconstructs the exact 'future upstream re-sync silently regresses' risk that motivated the added test. X gestures at the same blast-radius theme but more weakly ('note in test plan') and pads its comment budget with three near-duplicate restatements of the same Part1/Part2 interaction plus two Cosmos3 confirmations, diluting distinct signal. Both are richly grounded with specific file:line evidence beyond the visible diff and give concrete, actionable remedies, but Y's findings are more diverse and better matched to what the human reviewers actually asked for.
